seeds.text: Someone interrupts you for the third time in a meeting. What happens in the next ten seconds? What do you do an hour later?
followUpHints: Did you say anything in the moment?
How long did it stay with you?

seeds.text: Finish this honestly: "I lose patience fastest when…"
followUpHints: Can you give me the last time that happened?
What did you do?

seeds.text: You open a message that criticizes something you made. What's your first reaction - in your body and your head - and what do you do before replying?
followUpHints: How long before you replied?
What did the reply say?

seeds.text: Finish this: "The fastest way to calm me down is…"
followUpHints: Who or what usually does that?
When did it last work?

seeds.text: A plan you were counting on falls through at the last minute. Walk me through the next hour.
followUpHints: What was the very first thing you did?
Did you tell anyone how you felt?

seeds.text: Finish this: "I know I'm anxious when I start…"
followUpHints: What do others notice first?
What do you do once you notice?

seeds.text: Someone you love snaps at you unfairly. What do you do in the moment?
followUpHints: Did you snap back, go quiet, or something else?
What did you do an hour later?

seeds.text: Finish this: "When I'm overwhelmed, the first thing I drop is…"
followUpHints: What's an example?
Do you notice at the time, or later?

seeds.text: You're stuck and will clearly be late for something that matters. What's happening in your head and body?
followUpHints: What do you do with that feeling?
Do you let the other person know?

seeds.text: Finish this: "I feel most settled when…"
followUpHints: When did you last feel that?
What makes it hard to get there?

seeds.text: A stranger is rude to you in public. What do you actually do?
followUpHints: Did you respond or let it go?
How did you feel afterward?

seeds.text: Finish this: "The feeling I'm worst at handling is…"
followUpHints: What do you do when it shows up?
Give me a recent example.
